entries.dialogueText: "Seeing as I hold the pen, it’s my hand that will shape the record of what’s to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall see.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your service has been noted, but i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your service has been noted, but it ends here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The throne belongs to one person,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The throne belongs to one person, and it’s not you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took the pen and signed my name t..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the pen and signed my name to the decree.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Let it be known that from this day..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let it be known that from this day forward, Hugo, you shall no longer hold your title, nor shall Ricardus or Hubertus.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Congratulations. Your blood is wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations. Your blood is worth no more than that of a commoner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Henceforth, I strip you of your ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Henceforth, I strip you of your titles, erasing all your rights, privileges, and noble standing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go with God.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go with God."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's your cue to leave.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's your cue to leave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's now enjoy the rest of the ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's now enjoy the rest of the evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope there won't be any misunder..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope there won't be any misunderstandings after tonight."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Why am I not surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "Why am I not surprised."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Lucita? Why am I not surprised tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita? Why am I not surprised that you'd be mixed up in all of this."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Lucita? I should have known you'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita? I should have known you'd be mixed up in all of this."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I can’t say I’m surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can’t say I’m surprised."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Mixed up? Oh, no, Angelica, I pref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mixed up? Oh, no, Angelica, I prefer to call it ‘contributing strategically.’"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Mixed up? Oh, no, Leona, I prefer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mixed up? Oh, no, Leona, I prefer to call it ‘contributing strategically.’"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Let's just say being married to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just say being married to the King has its... advantages."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A few well-placed words ensured th..."
entries.dialogueText: "A few well-placed words ensured the right guards within your House stayed loyal and stood down at this crucial moment."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His Majesty will explain the rest.""
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty will explain the rest."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My loyalty to my husband means doi..."
entries.dialogueText: "My loyalty to my husband means doing everything in my power to be supportive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, a knock at the door..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, a knock at the door drew everyone's attention. One of the guards stepped forward to open it, revealing Lucita.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In her hands was a leather-bound fo..."
entries.dialogueText: In her hands was a leather-bound folder, which she handed directly to Titus when she stepped inside.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Queen Consort Lucita? You mean to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Consort Lucita? You mean to tell me you're mixed up in all of this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, a knock at the door..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, a knock at the door drew everyone's attention. One of the guards stepped forward to open it, revealing Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In his hands was a leather-bound fo..."
entries.dialogueText: In his hands was a leather-bound folder, which he handed directly to Titus when he stepped inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus stepped back, leaving Hugo al..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus stepped back, leaving Hugo alone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona stepped back, leaving Hugo al..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona stepped back, leaving Hugo alone.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh, don't mind me. I'm just making..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, don't mind me. I'm just making sure my team executed everything properly. Pretend like I'm not even here."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should have known you’d be invol..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have known you’d be involved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That's when Rusty stepped inside, d..."
entries.dialogueText: That's when Rusty stepped inside, drawing everyone's attention.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Always a businessman first. No loy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Always a businessman first. No loyalty to anything but your own damn profits."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Rusty!?""
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty!?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Not a shred of honor in your bones.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not a shred of honor in your bones."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Mr. Montoro! I should have known y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro! I should have known you’d be involved."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Never one to care for borders, loy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never one to care for borders, loyalty, or anything beyond your own gain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus heaved a sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Manus heaved a sigh.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Mr. Montoro. Selling your allegian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro. Selling your allegiance to the highest bidder, as usual."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""A businessman above all, with no a..."
entries.dialogueText: "A businessman above all, with no allegiance beyond your bottom line."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I prefer to call it pragmatism.""
entries.dialogueText: "I prefer to call it pragmatism."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Very well. Enjoy your moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Enjoy your moment."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Mr. Montoro? Of course, you're inv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro? Of course, you're involved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think it's best you step out, Ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's best you step out, Rusty. The room is no place for a spectator."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you can see, your men performed..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you can see, your men performed with the utmost proficiency and skill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you're going to pretend you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're going to pretend you're not here, Rusty, why not do it somewhere else?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Fine, fine, I’ll take my leave. Do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine, fine, I’ll take my leave. Don't miss me too much."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His guards supervised him as he wal..."
entries.dialogueText: His guards supervised him as he walked out. All eyes were now on me.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm glad to hear it. Anyway, I let..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it. Anyway, I let you get back to your little pow-wow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know those nobles titles and p..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know those nobles titles and privilege you hold so dear? Well, you can kiss them goodbye."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To put it simply... You're to form..."
entries.dialogueText: "To put it simply... You're to formally agree to forfeit your noble title and the privileges that come with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have a simple choice -- actual..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have a simple choice -- actually, scratch that. There’s no choice here. You’re to be stripped of your noble title. Period."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please just sign the papers you'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please just sign the papers you'll be passed. You will be free to go after you let go of your noble privileges and titles."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""This is outrageous!""
entries.dialogueText: "This is outrageous!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But, Your Majest-""
entries.dialogueText: "But, Your Majest-"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Why, that's ridiculous!""
entries.dialogueText: "Why, that's ridiculous!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos rose to his feet, his mouth..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos rose to his feet, his mouth opening to voice a protest, but he was swiftly shoved back into his seat by the armed men surrounding him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita rose to her feet, her mouth..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita rose to her feet, her mouth opening to voice a protest, but she was swiftly shoved back into her seat by the armed men surrounding her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus grabbed his cane and attemp..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus grabbed his cane and attempted to rise to his feet, but he was swiftly shoved back into his wheelchair by the armed men surrounding him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona rose to her feet, her mouth o..."
entries.dialogueText: Leona rose to her feet, her mouth opening to voice a protest, but she was swiftly shoved back into her seat by the armed men surrounding her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica rose to her feet, her mout..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica rose to her feet, her mouth opening to voice a protest, but she was swiftly shoved back into her seat by the armed men surrounding her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo rose to his feet, his mouth op..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo rose to his feet, his mouth opening to voice a protest, but he was swiftly shoved back into his seat by the armed men surrounding him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico rose to his feet, his mouth op..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico rose to his feet, his mouth opening to voice a protest, but he was swiftly shoved back into his seat by the armed men surrounding him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus extended the folder to me, an..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus extended the folder to me, and I opened it, revealing the documents inside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent, ignoring him compl..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent, ignoring him completely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Placing a pen on top, I looked at L..."
entries.dialogueText: Placing a pen on top, I looked at Leona with a measured gaze.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sat in stunned silence, the gra..."
entries.dialogueText: She sat in stunned silence, the gravity of the situation dawning on her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. That settles it then.""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry that it had to come to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry that it had to come to this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It doesn't have to. There's still..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't have to. There's still time for you to walk away."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Come to what exactly?""
entries.dialogueText: "Come to what exactly?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Your Majesty, please. What do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, please. What do you want from my house?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The heavy double doors crashed open..."
entries.dialogueText: The heavy double doors crashed open, and Wruhec’s Guardians, led by Captain Castellanus, stormed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guests barely had time to react."
entries.dialogueText: My guests barely had time to react.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leona barely had time to react."
entries.dialogueText: Leona barely had time to react.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Stay where you are, Hugo.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Stay where you are, Hugo.”

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Titus! What the hell are you doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus! What the hell are you doing?!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stood with a few other Guardi..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stood with a few other Guardians, weapons leveled at the stunned nobles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Guardians were relentless as th..."
entries.dialogueText: The Guardians were relentless as they secured the room with aggressive efficiency, blocking every possible escape route.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Captain Gordion! Please do somethi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion! Please do something!"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Captain! What in God's name are yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain! What in God's name are you doing?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus raised his firearm."
entries.dialogueText: Titus raised his firearm.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Stay where you are!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Stay where you are!”

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Room secure, sir. Divus gidatu gai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Room secure, sir. Divus gidatu gaitu eta libratu gaitu."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That translated to, "The Lord has g..."
entries.dialogueText: That translated to, "The Lord has guided our hands and delivered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once that was done, Captain Castell..."
entries.dialogueText: Once that was done, Captain Castellanus approached Titus.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Nice to see you too, Sazon. Though..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nice to see you too, Sazon. Though I'm offended by your characterization of me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I simply don't know where you're g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I simply don't know where you're getting this from. I urge you to stop this madness now."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Not you too, Your Grace. You have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not you too, Your Grace. You have to stop him."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Not you too, Your Grace. You have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not you too, Your Grace. You have to stop him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Silence. This will all be over qui..."
entries.dialogueText: "Silence. This will all be over quickly if you do as His Majesty asks."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the room."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord has judged you, and found..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord has judged you, and found you wanting. But the light of justice has pierced your dark veil of treachery."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I allowed Titus to lead everyone el..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed Titus to lead everyone else out of the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I allowed Titus and Hugo to lead ev..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed Titus and Hugo to lead everyone else out of the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I allowed Lucita to lead everyone e..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed Lucita to lead everyone else out of the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shouts of shock and confusion rang..."
entries.dialogueText: Shouts of shock and confusion rang out from the guests in the atrium as they entered. I took one final glance at the walls around me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The trophies of old victories hung..."
entries.dialogueText: The trophies of old victories hung like ghosts, their somber presence now tempered by the gleam of fresh triumphs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Long live the King."
entries.dialogueText: Long live the King.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll

entries.dialogueText: "I believe I made myself clear."
